title: select_gc_candidates does not apply pinned-CID check — relies solely on policy engine
description: gc_candidates.rs select_gc_candidates evaluates the policy engine in-process against the articles table. It does NOT check whether the CID is actually pinned in IPFS (no call to pin_client.is_pinned). If a CID was pinned by an external operator action (outside stoa) or by the remote pin worker, GC will still call unpin() on it. The GC candidate selection should either check pin status, or the system should document explicitly that external pins are not respected and operators must not pin CIDs outside stoa.
